summary: Build practical SEO skills in audits, keywords, technical fixes, and reporting. Train with proven tools and templates.
lede: SEO training helps digital content and website professionals improve page visibility through structured research and optimisation. It covers identifying search intent and target keywords, auditing crawl and indexing issues, and refining page content and internal links. Participants also practise interpreting organic performance data and turning findings into clear actions.
audienceIntro: This Search Engine Optimisation (SEO) training is intended for professionals who already work with digital content, website performance, or organic growth and now need a more structured way to improve search results.
modules: Keyword Research with Ahrefs and SEMrush
prerequisites: You should have basic familiarity with websites, digital content, and common marketing terminology. Prior experience with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, or SEMrush is helpful but not required. No coding/programming is required to complete the course, although a working understanding of HTML elements such as titles, headings, and meta descriptions will help you apply the material faster. The course treats advanced topics such as schema markup and technical SEO at an operational level, with implementation guidance framed for practical use rather than developer-level engineering.
